events.title: Peace hinges on people-centred policing, global summit hears
events.summary: Policing is the cornerstone of peace, said top UN officials ahead of the fifth UN Chiefs of Police Summit, which began on Tuesday.

events.title: UN maritime agency seeks release of 44 detained seafarers as food runs low
events.summary: The UN’s International Maritime Organization (IMO) appealed on Monday for the urgent release of 44 seafarers held captive in Somali waters by pirates and armed robbers.

events.title: Ukraine: Latest Russian assault leaves at least 14 dead in Kyiv
events.summary: Russian strikes on the Ukrainian capital Kyiv killed at least 14 civilians and injured more than 80 others overnight on Monday, according to local authorities.

events.title: Invisible peacebuilders: How ‘diplomacy works’ to prevent conflict
events.summary: Described as “sometimes modest, sometimes historic,” UN special political missions have quietly been preventing the escalation of conflicts during the organization’s 80-year history, becoming a key instrument for maintaining peace.

events.title: Civilian dangers multiply as drones transform Ukraine's battlefield
events.summary: As drones reshape the battlefield in Ukraine, they are also creating new and increasingly complex dangers for civilians, threatening recovery efforts, agriculture and global food security long after the fighting ends.

events.title: Sudan’s people subject to ‘relentless’ drone strikes in El Obeid
events.summary: The war in Sudan threatens to spiral further as the strategically-important town of El Obeid continues to face “relentless” drone attacks by advancing paramilitary militias, the UN’s human rights chief, Volker Türk, said on Friday.

events.title: Ukraine: Rescuers work to save trapped residents after wave of Russian attacks
events.summary: Aid agencies in Ukraine on Thursday rushed to respond to a massive uptick in deadly strikes by Russia, including one of the largest attacks on Kyiv to date.

events.title: World News in Brief: Risk of atrocities in Sudan, UN programme prevents climate displacement, more civilians killed in Ukraine
events.summary: Drone attacks by advancing rebel fighters who are besieging El Obeid, Sudan, continue to result in civilian casualties, putting around half a million civilians at grave risk of large-scale atrocities.

events.title: Expanding areas under Israeli control in Gaza increase risks to civilians, UN warns
events.summary: The continued expansion of areas under Israeli control in Gaza since October’s ceasefire agreement is placing civilians at greater risk and severely constraining humanitarian operations, the UN and humanitarian partners warned on Wednesday.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz: Gradual re-opening is no quick fix for developing nations, UN warns
events.summary: Re-opening the Strait of Hormuz would bring vital relief for many economies, but developing countries will continue to grapple with increased food and fuel costs, according to a new UN report released on Tuesday.

events.title: World News in Brief: Afghanistan airstrikes, rights violations in DR Congo, Gaza displacement
events.summary: At least 28 civilians were killed and 49 injured in airstrikes carried out in Paktya, Paktika and Kunar provinces in Afghanistan on Sunday evening, the UN Mission in the country has reported.

events.title: International cooperation critical as terrorism threat evolves
events.summary: Terrorism is evolving amid global instability characterised by heightened geopolitical tensions, protracted conflicts and growing fragmentation – and the international response must also evolve to meet the challenge.
